The Greatest (2026)
From a young boy named Cassius Clay to the man the world would come to know as Muhammad Ali, this is the extraordinary journey of a fighter who refused to be ordinary. With unmatched confidence, speed, and determination, Ali rises through the boxing ranks, challenging opponents and proving that greatness is earned both inside and outside the ring.
But fame comes with its own battles. As he becomes a global sporting sensation, Ali faces personal struggles, public criticism, and difficult decisions that test his character. His journey becomes about more than winning championships; it becomes a fight for identity, freedom, and the right to stand by his beliefs.
A powerful story of courage, resilience, and a man who changed the world through his words and actions.
Starring Jaalen Best, Omari Hardwick, Michael Ealy and Giovanni Ribisi.
